**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") already satisfies the preferred playbook position, and in places improves on it:

- **11.1** — up to six months of transition assistance on our request, priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form (better than "then-current rates"), and expressly including knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, and continued service at existing scope and service levels.
- **11.2** — return of all Customer Data within thirty days of our request in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, plus an express bar on withholding data over a fee dispute.
- **11.3** — deletion only *after* we confirm successful return, with written certification by an authorized officer and protection of any legally required retained copy.

Cross-checks: §10.1 ends access only after the agreed transition period and preserves Customer Data rights; §15.1 restricts Vendor use of Customer Data; and no suspension or payment-condition right (§§7, 9, 13) permits Vendor to hold data hostage. Walk-away risks (no data return, immediate deletion) are absent.
